title: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.15964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass. Verifying a rewrite by agent rollout is expensive and subjective, while executable checks such as the repository's own tests are too sparse to catch behavior-changing rewrites, rejecting only a quarter of them. We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm, so that the signal is dense and informative. TeSearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 real-world modules and three backbones, TeSearch delivers the highest-quality suites of any method compared, LLM-driven evolutionary

translated_title: 小而强大：测试套件作为自进化智能体的改进信号
translated_abstract: 自进化智能体会重写自身的运行框架，并必须决定保留哪些重写，因此其改进信号就是重写所必须通过的检查。通过智能体滚动来验证重写既昂贵又主观，而诸如代码库自身测试这样的可执行检查又过于稀疏，无法捕捉改变行为的重写，只能拒绝其中约四分之一。我们转而将测试反馈作为可执行信号，并用质量-多样性进化算法搜索既小又强的测试套件，使信号既密集又富有信息量。TeSearch 将套件大小作为行为描述符，从而在每种规模上都追求质量，使小而强的套件可达，并在搜索过程中学习一个转移核，对作为执行器的 LLM 在该描述符上进行去噪。在 129 个真实世界模块和三个骨干模型上，TeSearch 提供了所有对比方法中质量最高的测试套件，优于 LLM 驱动的进化方法。
tldr: 提出 TeSearch，通过质量-多样性进化算法搜索小而强的测试套件，为自进化智能体提供密集且可执行的改进信号，在 129 个真实模块和三个骨干模型上取得最高质量的套件。
en_tdlr: TeSearch uses a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm to find small yet strong test suites, providing dense executable improvement signals for self-evolving agents and achieving the highest-quality suites across 129 real-world modules and three backbones.
